directive.quote: For valuable work, inspect the actual behavior and integrate the final correct implementation into the default branch using ordinary commits.

preserve: Current recording session ownership, journals, pause/resume, device cleanup and VisualDatabase-owned recording library.
allowed_deltas: Return saved source and optional transcription references through an owner-declared completion target captured at session start and retained in its journal.
banned_substitutions: Do not restore obsolete component-owned recording lifetimes or duplicate library rendering.

baseline.note: Retained repository behavior; no appearance redesign or deployed proof claim.

proof.note: Source/component tests; the owner must validate completion requests.
